issue.title: Viewing and listening to resources Audit
issue.body:
Audit the Viewing and listening to resources against related GitHub issues and expected behavior. Test the latest supported mobile build, document results, and create `dev ready` issues for any identified gaps.

**Done when:** The assessment is merged, all gaps are linked to actionable issues, and the audit result is posted to this sub-ticket.

comments.body:
## Viewing and listening to resources audit — result

**Overall:** Pass with gaps

**Assessment PR (draft):** https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/590

**Assessment (on the branch until merge):** `docs/assessments/viewing-and-listening-to-resources/README.md`

**Build / env:** local run of merged `main` @ `fb634e5` (`expo-dev-client` + Metro, dev LogBox) against `dev.api.fluent.bible`
**Device:** Xiaomi Redmi Note 9 Pro, Android 10 (API 29), physical device

**Summary:** Online, the Resources tab works: tab order, unit sync, scroll and accordion restore, the Translation Notes and Questions accordions, image zoom and fullscreen, and Retry after the network returns. The source audio player passes its lifecycle checks: placement on Bible and Record, play/pause, stopping on leave, exclusivity with draft takes, stopping at the end of the chapter, and the no-audio state. The main risks are content coverage. In pericope mode, Resources shows only the first verse (#593). Source audio cannot follow verses because no dev project has verse timestamps (#595). Images show no attribution, which may be a licensing question (#594). All three need fluent-api work, tracked in fluent-mobile for now (the fluent-api tasks are opened at implementation time). Whether #593, #594 and #595 are launch blockers is to be decided with product. Offline reading of prepared content stays with #578 and #417 (going offline audit), and the source-audio scrub with #408.

**Gaps:**

| Gap | Finding | Severity | Launch blocker | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Empty Translation Notes / Questions sections are shown online; TQ loads only on expand | Medium | No | #591 |
| 2 | The offline empty message flashes while connectivity is resolving | Low | No | #592 |
| 3 | Pericope mode shows Resources for the first verse only (needs fluent-api) | High | To be decided with product | #593 |
| 4 | Images & Maps show no caption or attribution (needs fluent-api) | Medium | To be decided with product | #594 |
| 5 | Source audio does not follow verses without verse timestamps (needs fluent-api / data) | High | To be decided with product | #595 |
| 6 | "Maximum update depth exceeded" while using the source audio player | Medium | No | #596 (related to #569) |
| 7 | The Maestro images fullscreen smoke never opens fullscreen | Low (test infra) | No | #597 |

Will post the merged assessment link here after #590 merges.

## Viewing and listening to resources audit — tests executed

These are the tests run to reach the results and gaps in this audit.

All tests were run on a physical Android device with access to Wi-Fi and mobile data.

### A. Resources tab

- **A.1** Open a chapter and look at the drafting tab row. Expected: tabs in the order Bible, Resources, Record; Resources always visible.
- **A.2** Go to a verse with Translation Notes, Translation Questions and images, then open Resources. Expected: verse reference in the header; the three sections collapsed, each with its icon (open book, question bubble, images).
- **A.3** Change the verse with the Record chevrons or by tapping a verse on Bible, then return to Resources. Expected: content follows the new verse immediately.
- **A.4** On verse X, open Translation Notes and scroll down; go to verse Y, then back to X. Expected: open sections and scroll position restored.
- **A.5** Go to a verse with no resources at all. Expected: no sections; centered "No resources available for this verse".
- **A.6** Go to a verse missing one resource type (e.g. no Translation Questions) and expand each section. Expected: the section for the missing type is hidden.
- **A.7** Open Resources right after entering drafting, while the screen is still loading. Expected: a loading indicator, then the sections.

### B. Translation Notes

- **B.7** Expand Translation Notes. Expected: one collapsed accordion per note.
- **B.8** Open a note. Expected: paragraphs and lists preserved.

### C. Translation Questions

- **C.9** Expand Translation Questions. Expected: questions listed; each answer hidden until its question is tapped.

### D. Images & Maps

- **D.10** Expand Images & Maps. Expected: each thumbnail shows a title or caption and an attribution.
- **D.11** Pinch to zoom directly on a thumbnail. Expected: the thumbnail zooms.
- **D.12** Tap the maximize icon to open fullscreen; pinch, pan, check the title, then exit with Close and with the Android Back button. Expected: pinch-zoom and pan work; title shown; both Close and Back exit.

### E. Error and Retry (chapter prepared for offline)

- **E.13** Open a chapter prepared for offline, turn on airplane mode, open Resources and expand the sections. Expected: an inline error with Retry in each section, without blocking the other sections.
- **E.14** Turn airplane mode off and tap Retry in each section. Expected: the section content loads.

### F. Pericope mode

- **F.15** Switch to Pericope in Settings, select a multi-verse pericope on Bible, open Resources, and compare with the notes of the pericope's second verse in Verse mode. Expected: the pericope range in the header and resources for every verse in the pericope.

### G. Source audio (Verse mode)

- **G.16** Look at the source audio player on Bible, Resources and Record. Expected: player shown on Bible and Record, not on Resources; label "<Bible> Source Audio · Verse N / M".
- **G.17** Play, pause, then play again. Expected: real duration shown; playback resumes where it was paused.
- **G.18** With audio stopped, tap verse 5, then press Play. Expected: verse 5 selected with no auto-play; Play starts at verse 5.
- **G.19** While audio is playing, tap verse 8. Expected: playback moves to verse 8 and continues.
- **G.20** While audio is playing, watch the verse list. Expected: the row highlight follows the playing verse; the left border stays on the selected verse; the selection does not change on its own.
- **G.21** Select verse 1, press Play and do not scroll. Expected: when playback reaches a verse off-screen, the list scrolls to it.
- **G.22** Drag the scrubber near the end and let the chapter finish. Expected: playback stops without looping and the verse highlight clears.
- **G.23** Drag the scrubber to the middle of the waveform, about five times. Expected: playback moves to that position and does not restart.
- **G.24** While audio is playing, open Resources, then go back to Bible. Expected: playback pauses and resumes from the same position.
- **G.25** While audio is playing, leave drafting with the Back button. Expected: the audio stops.
- **G.26** On Record, play the source audio, then play a take; then start a recording. Expected: the source audio stops when the take plays; the player is hidden during recording.
- **G.27** Open a project without source audio. Expected: a "No source audio" state, with no crash.
- **G.x** Use only the source audio player on the Bible tab (play, pause, verse taps, scrub), with no draft takes played. Expected: no React errors in the dev LogBox.

@Roslin22

## Viewing and listening to resources — retest

> **Note:** this test script was generated with the help of AI, from the tests executed in the #531 audit (epic #526) and from other information gathered while the issues were implemented. It is a guide, not a limit: any other test that covers these points or goes beyond them is also valid.

> **Linked issues:** when a test ends with an issue number in parentheses, for example `(#591)` at the end of A.5, that is the sub-issue that fixed that point, so you can open it to see what was changed. Some of these issues are still open or depend on work that is not finished yet (for example, fluent-api changes). Those tests are marked with "issue still open" or "may fail". For them, a failure may be expected for now: report what you see, but it does not necessarily mean the fix regressed.

"Source audio" is the player with an audio wave shown on the Bible and Record tabs, which plays the chapter reading.

**What to prepare:** a verse with notes, questions and images (e.g. Mark 1); a verse with no notes (e.g. Psalms 10:1); a chapter with no resources at all; a chapter downloaded with Prepare for Offline; a project with no source audio; a project with pericopes. For block G2, a project whose source audio has verse marks on the wave (no dev project has them today — depends on fluent-api#374).

### A. Resources tab

- [ ] **A.1** Open a chapter and look at the tabs at the top. Expected: in the order Bible, Resources, Record; Resources is always shown.
- [ ] **A.2** Pick a verse that has notes, questions and images, and open Resources. Expected: the verse is shown at the top; the three sections (Translation Notes, Translation Questions, Images & Maps) are closed, each with its icon (open book, question bubble, images).
- [ ] **A.3** Change the verse with the arrows on the Record tab or by tapping a verse on the Bible tab, then return to Resources. Expected: the content is already for the new verse.
- [ ] **A.4** On verse X, open Translation Notes and scroll down; go to verse Y and back to X. Expected: the sections that were open are still open and the screen returns to the same scroll position.
- [ ] **A.5** Go to a verse with no resources. Expected: no sections, only the message "No resources available for this verse" in the middle of the screen. (#591)
- [ ] **A.6** Go to a verse that is missing one type of resource (e.g. Psalms 10:1, no notes) and open the sections. Expected: the section for the missing type is not shown at all; no section opens empty. (#591)
- [ ] **A.6b** Open Translation Questions on Mark 1, close it and open it again. Expected: the questions show at once, with no loading when the section opens and without staying blank. (#591)
- [ ] **A.7** Open Resources right after entering the chapter, while it is still loading. Expected: a loading indicator, then the sections; the message "No resources are on this device yet" never flashes on screen. (#592)

### B. Translation Notes

- [ ] **B.7** Open Translation Notes. Expected: each note is shown closed, one below the other.
- [ ] **B.8** Open a note. Expected: the text keeps its paragraphs and lists.

### C. Translation Questions

- [ ] **C.9** Open Translation Questions. Expected: the questions are shown; the answer only appears when you tap the question.

### D. Images & Maps

- [ ] **D.10** Open Images & Maps. Expected: each image shows a title or caption and the credit (attribution). (#594 — issue still open; depends on fluent-api sending caption and credit. Until then, only the title is expected.)
- [ ] **D.11** Pinch directly on a small image. Expected: the image zooms.
- [ ] **D.12** Tap the expand icon to open the image full screen; zoom, drag, check the title; leave with the Close button and, again, with the Android back button. Expected: the full-screen image is sharp (full size); zoom and drag work; the title is shown; both ways of leaving work. (#594)

### E. Error and "Retry" (chapter downloaded for offline)

- [ ] **E.13** Open a chapter downloaded with Prepare for Offline, turn on airplane mode, open Resources and open the sections. Expected: the downloaded content is shown. If a section has no downloaded content, it shows an error with a Retry button without affecting the others. (#578 — issue still open)
- [ ] **E.14** Turn airplane mode off and tap Retry on the sections with an error. Expected: the content loads, and no section opens blank. (#591)

### F. Pericope mode

- [ ] **F.15** In Settings, set "Drafting unit" to Pericope. On the Bible tab, pick a pericope with several verses and open Resources. Compare with the notes of that pericope's second verse in Verse mode. Expected: the top shows the pericope range, and resources for every verse in the pericope are shown (including the second verse's), with no repeated items. (#593)
- [ ] **F.16** Set "Drafting unit" back to Verse and open Resources. Expected: the top shows chapter and verse (e.g. "Mark 1:3"), not just the verse number. (#593)

### G. Source audio (Verse mode) — project **without** verse marks on the wave

- [ ] **G.16** Look at the source audio player on the Bible, Resources and Record tabs. Expected: shown on Bible and Record, not on Resources; the text reads "<Bible> Source Audio · Verse N / M".
- [ ] **G.17** Play, pause and play again. Expected: the real length is shown; the audio continues from where it stopped.
- [ ] **G.18** With the audio playing in the middle of the chapter, tap another verse. Expected: the audio does **not** go back to 0:00 or restart the chapter; it continues from where it was. (#595)
- [ ] **G.19** Pause in the middle, tap another verse and press Play. Expected: the audio continues from where it was, not from the start. (#595)
- [ ] **G.22** Drag the player bar near the end and let it finish. Expected: the audio stops at the end without starting over, and the verse highlight goes away.
- [ ] **G.23** Drag the player bar to the middle of the wave, about five times. Expected: the audio goes to that point and does not jump back to the start. (#408 — issue still open)
- [ ] **G.24** While the audio plays, go to Resources and back to Bible. Expected: the audio pauses and continues from the same point.
- [ ] **G.25** While the audio plays, leave the chapter with the back button. Expected: the audio stops.
- [ ] **G.26** On the Record tab, play the source audio, then play a take; then start recording. Expected: the source audio stops when the take starts; the player is hidden while recording.
- [ ] **G.27** Open a project with no source audio. Expected: "No source audio" is shown, and the app does not close.
- [ ] **G.28** Use only the Bible tab player for a while (play, pause, tap verses, drag the bar), without playing takes. Expected: the app does not freeze, slow down or close on its own. (#596)

### G2. Source audio — project **with** verse marks on the wave

Depends on fluent-api#374. If no project has verse marks on the wave, skip this block and note it.

- [ ] **G.18t** With the audio stopped, tap verse 5 and then Play. Expected: verse 5 is selected without playing on its own; when you press Play, it starts at verse 5. (#595)
- [ ] **G.19t** While the audio plays, tap verse 8. Expected: the audio jumps to verse 8 and keeps playing. (#595)
- [ ] **G.20t** While the audio plays, watch the verse list. Expected: the highlight follows the verse being played; the bar on the left stays on the verse you selected; the selection does not change on its own. (#595)
- [ ] **G.21t** Select verse 1, press Play and do not scroll. Expected: when the audio reaches a verse off screen, the list scrolls to it on its own. (#595)

### Engineering check (QA can skip)

- [ ] **X.1** The automated (Maestro) full-screen image test really opens and closes full screen. (#597)
